sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Our position
move.body: Thank you for your quote. I will be direct: the announced increase is difficult for us, and I had expected more room from a supplier of twelve years.

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We deeply value our twelve-year partnership and are pleased to accept your request for a 24-month contract to ensure mutual stability.
As a family-run foundry, a 60-day payment term is challenging for us, so we ask to meet halfway at 45 days.
With this adjustment, we are prepared to lower our offer to €52.20 per unit.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €52.00 per unit.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Our position
move.body: I am somewhat disappointed. We bring you stable volume and prompt payment, and the response so far does not reflect that. Our revised position follows.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

You mention stable volume; please share your detailed volume projections so we can properly evaluate them. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? Without this data, we must hold our position at €52.20 for 60-day payment terms, as we have already made significant steps to accommodate your requests. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is … days net.

move.subject: Our position
move.body: This is my third move without any real movement on your side. I would like a reason to keep defending this relationship internally.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. The offer is valid for 7 days.

As requested in our last message, we still need your detailed volume projections to evaluate any further adjustments. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
